notes: This portable C++ TCK pair observes a joined-federate MOM object through the official discovery/reflection API, queries RTI ownership of one predefined MOM instance attribute before and after both public ownership-acquisition forms, and checks for no ownership-transfer notification or federate release request. The API does not prescribe the response to the attempted requests. Adapter configuration supplies the package, endpoint, application FOM, standard MIM, logical-time implementation, and callback model. No conformance claim is made.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MIM federation creation, join, object-class/attribute lookup, active subscription, queryAttributeOwnership, ownership acquisition, and lifecycle; FederateAmbassador discoverObjectInstance, reflectAttributeValues, attributeIsOwnedByRTI, attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification, and requestAttributeOwnershipRelease observation
